say:1:1322536001:1.text: Maybe Chippy spoke too soon... but Magister, these fish don't look big enough.
say:1:1322536001:1.source_cn: 主人，可能满满有点多嘴，感觉这鱼还是不够大？
say:1:1322536001:1.male: Maybe Chippy spoke too soon... but Magister, these fish don't look big enough.
say:1:1322536001:1.female: Maybe Chippy spoke too soon... but Magister, these fish don't look big enough.

say:2:1322536002:1.text: Could be the wrong fishing spot. Maybe we should ask around for a better one.
say:2:1322536002:1.source_cn: 是不是咱们钓点找错了，要不咱问问周围钓鱼的人吧。
